note: Compute budget per registered attack. All runs CPU-only, offline, no A10/TDX/production-checkpoint use.

common.model: Qwen2.5-0.5B (real weights = SECRET private base; never exposed to any attacker function)
common.attacker_wall_rule: attack functions receive ONLY transformed tensors (*_tilde) + architecture; never plaintext W/H/masks or a public checkpoint
common.precision: float64 for attack math; float32 for logit-scale metrics

S1_representation_inversion.data: 40 natural-English prompts x up to 32 tokens -> a few thousand real hidden-state positions at 4 depths; plus a synthetic n=4000, d=896 invertibility probe

A1_svd.method: one truncated SVD of the masked product

S3_logit_leakage.method: one real forward; closed-form distributional metrics

S4_gradient_inversion.model: shallow supervised head (rmsnorm -> masked linear + rank-8 LoRA -> 2-class head)
S4_gradient_inversion.masked_model: exact Nr-conjugate of the plaintext head (the deployed fold)

deferred.external_baselines: STIP/ObfuscaTune/Amulet only if prior artifacts exist; not reproduced here
